---
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  total_synsets,
  total_senses,
  distinct_domains,
  distinct_posids,
  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   GROUP BY s.synsetid 
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC 
   LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 
                     WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid 
                     GROUP BY s2.synsetid 
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC 
                     LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2 
    AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY
  total_senses DESC,
  total_synsets DESC,
  distinct_domains DESC,
  word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;

command: sqlite3 -readonly /app/oewn.sqlite ".schema" && echo '--- INDEXES ---' && sqlite3 -readonly /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"

cd /app && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',COUNT(*) FROM synsets;" && echo '--- dup check ---' && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid HAVING COUNT(*)>1);" && echo '--- baseline timing ---' && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.out && wc -l /tmp/orig.out && md5sum /tmp/orig.out && head -3 /tmp/orig.out

cd /app && sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'dup_synsetids', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT synsetid FROM synsets GROUP BY synsetid HAVING COUNT(*)>1); SELECT 'dup_wordids', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid FROM words GROUP BY wordid HAVING COUNT(*)>1); SELECT 'distinct_word_synset_pairs', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid);" && cat <<'EOF' > /app/sol.sql
WITH j AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         s.synsetid AS synsetid,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         syn.domainid AS domainid,
         syn.posid AS posid
  FROM senses AS s
  JOIN synsets AS syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
agg AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM j
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT j.wordid AS wordid,
         j.synsetid AS synsetid,
         j.cnt AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.wordid ORDER BY j.cnt DESC, j.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM j
  JOIN agg ON agg.wordid = j.wordid
)
SELECT a.wordid AS word_id,
       wo.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets,
       a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains,
       a.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg AS a
JOIN words AS wo ON wo.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN ranked AS r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC,
         a.total_synsets DESC,
         a.distinct_domains DESC,
         a.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
echo '--- timing optimized ---' && time timeout 180 sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < /app/sol.sql > /tmp/sol.out && wc -l /tmp/sol.out && head -5 /tmp/sol.out

cd /app && cp -f oewn.sqlite /tmp/oewn_verify.sqlite && sqlite3 /tmp/oewn_verify.sqlite "CREATE INDEX idx_senses_wordid_synsetid ON senses(wordid,synsetid); CREATE INDEX idx_synsets_synsetid ON synsets(synsetid); CREATE INDEX idx_words_wordid ON words(wordid);" && time timeout 300 sqlite3 -readonly /tmp/oewn_verify.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.out && time sqlite3 -readonly oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/sol.out && if cmp -s /tmp/orig.out /tmp/sol.out; then echo MATCH; else echo MISMATCH; diff -u /tmp/orig.out /tmp/sol.out | head -60; exit 1; fi
